headers.comment: Firebase defaults HTML to max-age=3600, so returning visitors keep a stale page for an hour after every deploy. The HTML is small and names the hashed bundles, so it must always be revalidated. Matching only /index.html misses the common case: the request path for the home page is "/".
Vite content-hashes these filenames, so a changed file is a new URL and this can never go stale.
Images and logos keep stable filenames, so cache them hard but not immutably — replacing one should still reach visitors within a week.
